name: Text to Image (Dynamic)
description: Plans and generates one or more plain images from a text request, without adding video, audio, or social platform template stages.

planning.planning_notes: Set the number of images from the user's description. Plan the content first, then generate one image per plan item. Do not create video or audio nodes.
planning.prompt_guide: Each plan item describes one image: subject, scene, composition and style. Multiple images must keep the visual consistency the user asked for.
conduct_rules: Generate only the image stage the user asked for; do not add video or audio stages
Use only the capabilities declared in allowed_recipe_ids
Generate and confirm a dynamic plan before creating canvas nodes

rating_bands.description: Image nodes fully meet the user's goal and the workflow can run
Core image flow is complete; minor non-critical adjustments allowed
Missing a required planning or image generation stage

domain_constraints: The workflow contains only planning and image generation stages; never force video nodes
